name: Clear Temporary Files
description: Removes temporary files created by Windows, applications, and installers to free up disk space. Note that some data may be skipped if currently in use.

description_i18n.en: Removes temporary files created by Windows, applications, and installers to free up disk space. Note that some data may be skipped if currently in use.
description_i18n.de: Entfernt temporäre Dateien von Windows und Anwendungen zur Freigabe von Speicherplatz. Hinweis: Einige Daten werden übersprungen, wenn sie gerade verwendet werden.
description_i18n.fr: Supprime les fichiers temporaires créés par Windows et des applications pour libérer de l'espace disque. Note : certains éléments peuvent être ignorés s'ils sont en cours d'utilisation.

warnings.title: Local data cleanup
warnings.message: Cache or temporary data may be removed. Windows or apps may take a moment to rebuild it

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Removes files from the current user temp folder and system temporary directories where accessible
